title.value: GANSpiration: Balancing Targeted and Serendipitous Inspiration in User Interface Design with Style-Based Generative Adversarial Network
title.justification: The paper is about a new approach named GANSpiration that uses Style-Based Generative Adversarial Network (StyleGAN) to enhance inspiration in user interface design.
title.quote: GANSpiration: Balancing Targeted and Serendipitous Inspiration in User Interface Design with Style-Based Generative Adversarial Network.

extractions.description: The paper presents GANSpiration, a tool for user interface design that uses StyleGAN to provide a balance of targeted and serendipitous design inspiration. The tool suggests diverse yet relevant design examples to prevent design fixation and help designers explore new concepts.

primary_category.justification: The focus of the paper is on developing a tool for creativity in user interface design rather than addressing eco-responsible objectives or outcomes.
primary_category.quote: Our work paves the road of using advanced generative machine learning techniques in supporting the creative design practice.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not discuss eco-responsible themes or categories; it focuses on design inspiration and creativity support for user interface design.
secondary_categories.quote: GANSpiration-based approaches leverage the StyleGAN technique to perform style transfer and generate new design artifacts based on existing design artifacts and, therefore, provide a targeted and serendipitous inspiration for user interface designers.

primary_sub_category.justification: The research is not related to any eco-responsible sub-categories listed and is instead aimed at improving user interface design processes.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our study demonstrated the potential of GANSpiration in supporting both serendipitous and targeted inspirations.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The detailed sub-categories do not relate to the central objectives or applications detailed in the paper which are focused on user interface design.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: To use the capacity of StyleGAN in the context of UI design, we need to retrain the StyleGAN model with a dataset of user interface design artifacts.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper is primarily about providing design tools to support creativity through the generation of new and meaningful UI design ideas, which is not covered in the existing categories.
new_primary_category.quote: Our contribution, however, is not on using the most recent models, but instead on illustrating the potential of applying this line of work for a novel but important problem, i.e., generating design examples with high diversity and relevance for effective inspiration.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category should encompass the methods and tools to enhance creativity and inspiration specifically in user interface design.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: GANSpiration-based approaches leverage the StyleGAN technique to perform style transfer and generate new design artifacts based on existing design artifacts and, therefore, provide a targeted and serendipitous inspiration for user interface designers.
